name: mana-runtime
description: Cloudflare-native execution runtime for Mana operating agents

scripts.build:shared: pnpm -C packages/slack-thread-context build && pnpm -C packages/task-runtime-core build && pnpm -C packages/write-broker build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/slack-thread-context typecheck && pnpm -C packages/task-runtime-core typecheck && pnpm -C packages/write-broker typecheck && pnpm -C packages/cloud-runtime typecheck && pnpm -C packages/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/slack-thread-context test && pnpm -C packages/task-runtime-core test && pnpm -C packages/write-broker test && pnpm -C packages/cloud-runtime test
scripts.clean: pnpm -C packages/slack-thread-context clean && pnpm -C packages/task-runtime-core clean && pnpm -C packages/cloud-runtime clean && pnpm -C packages/web clean
